Ever wonder how many tokens you use or which AI models you reach for the most? In this demo, explore the My AI Usage Canvas, a custom dashboard built around Copilot /chronicle commands. Learn how to visualize your token consumption, track model usage across repositories, and find practical ways to lower your AI costs. Start analyzing your AI habits today: https://awesome-copilot.github.com/extension/chronicle-stats/
